title: Triangles inside a curved contour (Lyon)
description: Lyon tessellates an original curved contour at three tolerances. The displayed edges are the triangles produced by the native Rust tessellator.
description_ko: Lyon으로 직접 만든 곡선 윤곽을 세 허용 오차에서 삼각분할했어요. 네이티브 Rust 테셀레이터가 만든 삼각형의 변을 보여 줘요.
prompt: Triangles inside a curved contour. Edit the supplied Rust source and rerun the recipe to change computation inputs.
